jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a) inventory: Barstow Unified Union School District, a unified union district in the Rutland Northeast Supervisory Union (member towns Chittenden and Mendon).
Rutland Northeast Supervisory Union (official site hosting the district's board page).

sources.note: Barstow Unified Union School District board page (Rutland Northeast Supervisory Union, official): 'School Board Officers' -- Tony Roberts (At-Large - Chittenden, 2027, Chair); Justine Calnan Cavacas (Chittenden, 2027, Clerk); Deborah Singiser (At-Large - Chittenden, 2029); Leo Pond (Chittenden, 2028); Gregory Smith (Mendon, 2028). The board is five directors -- Chittenden 2, Mendon 1, At-Large 2 -- the town seats elected by that town's voters only and the at-large seats by both towns, per the district's formation articles as amended November 6, 2018 (second at-large seat added). Corroborated by the board's October 5, 2026 special-meeting minutes (Roberts, Singiser, Pond and Cavacas present) and, for Cavacas and Singiser, by RNESU's official March 4, 2026 results post naming them elected on March 3, 2026.
